scientific_integrity: Stationary formulas credited to existing literature; only exact derivative growth and quantified nonconstant Fourier phase assessed here. Numerical tests corroborate but do not establish the infinite claims.
scientific_limitations: One-dimensional Brownian motion, deterministic 0<q<1 contraction, independent Poisson events, no drift.
Nonzero oscillatory amplitude may be tiny for q near one; no practical detectability bound.
General q-product asymptotic machinery could imply aspects of this statement; priority is not independently confirmed.
title: Exact non-Gevrey derivatives and a log-periodic Fourier fingerprint of proportional Brownian resetting
